question: What is the cash position and runway?

beats.line: By September's end, Diginex held one point eight five million in cash.
beats.headline: $1.85M
events: A stack of paper coins drops onto the ground and settles, opening cold.
A black paper chip slaps into place beside the stack.
A paper hand presses the top coin flat as the chip holds.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] By September's end, Diginex held one point eight five million in cash.

beats.line: Six months earlier it was three point one one million.
beats.headline: $3.11M → $1.85M
events: The coin stack, already in place, is joined by a torn-paper arrow entering from the edge.
The arrow points down as the stack visibly shrinks coin by coin.
A second black chip slaps in beside the first, which stays exactly where it landed.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Six months earlier it was three point one one million.

beats.line: Operating burn ran about one point three million a month.
beats.headline: $1.3M / MONTH
events: Both violet-scene chips slide off the top edge as the arrow unrolls into a paper calendar strip on fresh magenta ground.
Paper coins slide off the strip, one month at a time.
A black chip slaps in, reading the monthly burn.
beats.delivery: Operating burn ran about one point three million a month.

beats.line: At that rate, the cash on hand covered one point four months.
beats.headline: 1.4 MONTHS
events: The strip, already in place, becomes a runway torn short as a cutout aircraft enters from the edge.
The aircraft rolls to the torn end and stops, the strip's chip staying exactly where it landed.
A paper hand enters and taps the aircraft as a larger black chip slaps in, the hero number printing large.
beats.delivery: [excited] At that rate, the cash on hand covered one point four months.

beats.line: October's warrant exercise added thirteen point eight million in cash.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
events: The magenta-scene runway chip and aircraft are covered as the ground returns to violet and the original coin stack reappears.
Fresh paper coins are taped onto the stack, one after another.
A black chip slaps in, and the hand presses the last coin flat.
beats.delivery: October's warrant exercise added thirteen point eight million in cash.

beats.line: Survival depends on capital markets and the next two quarters.
beats.headline: NEXT 2 QUARTERS
events: The coin stack, already in place, is joined by two calendar pages entering from the edge — the one new element in this closing shot.
A paper hand enters and points at the second page.
A black chip slaps in over the stack, closing the programme back where it began.
beats.delivery: Survival depends on capital markets and the next two quarters.
